Hi all,

Quick reminder that our weekly forecast submission window closes Monday EOD. This thread is the single place for the final updates we’ll use for the finance submission and the Monday pre-submission call. Please do the following before 4pm PT today: 

1) Update stage + commit on the shared sheet (linked below) for any deals you own. Use the "Lockbox" column to mark hard commits.
2) If a deal should move from "Best Case" to "Commit," add one-line rationale in the comment column and attach any supporting doc (SOW, signed PSA, PO).
3) Add any ask for the Monday call under the "Agenda" tab — we’ll prioritize escalations and deals needing executive support.

Primary links: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1XabcLockboxTemplate (weekend lockbox template)
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/9382

Attachments: weekend_lockbox_template.xlsx (sheet template), nimble_health_snapshot_Q3.pdf (snapshot of current Nimble Health book).

Agenda for Monday (10:00am PT):
- Quick roll call (5m)
- High-risk deals flagged in Lockbox (15m)
- Commit confirmations and required exec actions (25m)
- Operational blockers, legal/PO status (10m)

Please confirm you can get updates in by 4pm PT today. If you cannot, reply here with the ETA and we’ll stash the deal as "At Risk".

Thanks,
Chloe Martin
Senior Account Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

- Any deals with outstanding legal redlines or export control language remain At Risk until legal signs off.

Agenda update for Monday (10:00am PT):
1) Confirmed Lockbox commits (Marcus to read-out Nimble and ACME) — 12m
2) Executive actions needed (if any) — 10m
3) Ops blockers and next steps for At Risk deals — 8m

If there are no further changes, I’ll lock the sheet at 4pm PT and push this into finance for Monday morning consolidation. Thanks for the quick turn-around everyone.
